summary: Panel component for grouping buttons, sliders, viewer panels, containers, and other Panel Components into a control panel or movable/scalable UI cluster.

key_params.name: x
key_params.note: Panel X position relative to parent.

key_params.name: y
key_params.note: Panel Y position relative to parent.

key_params.name: hmode
key_params.note: Horizontal size mode: fixed, fill, or anchors.

key_params.name: vmode
key_params.note: Vertical size mode: fixed, fill, or anchors.

key_params.name: alignallow
key_params.note: Whether this panel follows parent alignment.

key_params.name: clickthrough
key_params.note: Ignore mouse clicks on this panel.

key_params.name: opacity
key_params.note: Panel opacity from the Look page.

key_params.name: topfill
key_params.note: How the Background TOP fills the panel.

key_params.name: composite
key_params.note: Panel compositing operation with sibling panels.

key_params.name: align
key_params.note: How child panels are laid out.

key_params.name: alignmax
key_params.note: Maximum children per row or column.

key_params.name: margin
key_params.note: Outer child-layout margin in absolute pixels.

key_params.name: fit
key_params.note: Scale child panels to fit the container.

key_params.name: crop
key_params.note: Crop child panels outside the container.

key_concepts: click(u, v, clickCount, force, left, middle, right)
common_gotchas: Container COMP is for grouping panels/UI, not for generic non-panel network packaging; use Base COMP when no panel behavior is needed.
Display can cause layout processing costs; opacity is often better for lightweight visual hiding when layout should stay stable.
Align Order belongs to children ordering; the main child layout mode is the Children page Align parameter.
Margin is defined in absolute pixels and may not appear in the node panel viewer the same way it appears in a floating window.
Background TOP uses the official top parameter; choose topfill and topsmoothness deliberately when displaying image-backed controls.
